stories.title: Scope Enforcement Contract Definition
stories.description: Define the contract for tool scope enforcement including allowed tool sets per capability (Find Care, Evaluate Care, Shared), request metadata requirements, and validation rules for scope mismatches.

stories.title: Core Scope Validation Logic in Tool Router
stories.description: Extend tool_router to enforce scope boundaries by validating each tool call against an explicit allowlist mapped to the active conversation context and capability. Reject out-of-scope tool calls before execution.

stories.title: Scope Violation Handling and Error Response
stories.description: Implement standardized error handling for scope violations including safe rejection messages, logging, and prevention of downstream execution. Ensure no sensitive system details are exposed.

stories.title: Integration with Facades and Capability Routing
stories.description: Integrate scope enforcement with existing facades (find_care_facade, evaluate_care_facade) ensuring that only tools relevant to the invoked facade can be executed within a request lifecycle.

stories.title: Scope Enforcement Test Suite
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating that out-of-scope tool calls are rejected, valid calls succeed, and edge cases (mixed intents, malformed requests) are handled correctly.
